Stock molarities and the underlying formulation are not independently recoverable from the exports. The [shared methods](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156#odor-2026-10-21-methods) give the full construct/stimulus mapping, calculation and provenance. ### Test 2: corrected changes and VUAA1-referenced responses ![Or35a: Test 2 corrected changes S and construct-matched VUAA1 reference ratios N](REGISTRY_IMAGE_UPLOAD_OR35A) *Upper panel: S = ΔF1 − ΔF0, in percentage points (pp), using the observed F1 change over 168 s and F0 change over 48 s. Lower panel: N = (S − DMSO S) / (VUAA1 S − DMSO S), the same dimensionless normalization used in the Results heatmap. DMSO is 0 and VUAA1 is 1 by definition; these anchors do not bound other responses. Negative values remain visible. Each condition–addition pair is one separate well.* [Full within-acquisition F0/F1 time courses](https://registry.igem.wiki/documentation/c09e424a-254d-42f7-9b0b-b8ba0e48659e/f713c4ba663254c55262e1d0563db68227cc4fb5ec2e55d32d0aa327dac815f4.avif). ΔF0 = 100 × (last F0 / first F0 − 1); ΔF1 = 100 × (last F1 / first F1 − 1). **S = ΔF1 − ΔF0**, in percentage points (pp). S48 repeats the calculation using only the first 48 s of F1 and the full 48 s of F0; it is a window sensitivity check, not an extra replicate. The separate DMSO-well contrast is shown alongside S rather than replacing it. | Well | Addition | ΔF0 (%) · 48 s | ΔF1 (%) · 168 s | S (pp) | S − vehicle S (pp) | S48 (pp) | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | A04 | VUAA1 | -2.57 | +34.09 | +36.67 | +38.06 | +19.67 | | D04 | Isopentyl acetate | -2.06 | -2.68 | -0.61 | +0.78 | +0.60 | | E04 | 2-Heptanone | -3.10 | -3.04 | +0.05 | +1.44 | +1.58 | | F04 | Valeric acid | -2.72 | -0.91 | +1.81 | +3.20 | +1.14 | | G04 | Pentyl acetate | -2.17 | -3.10 | -0.93 | +0.46 | +0.75 | | H04 | DMSO vehicle | -1.60 | -2.99 | -1.39 | +0.00 | -0.11 | ### Interpretation **Reading S and N together.** For this construct, VUAA1 has **S = +36.67 pp** and the separate DMSO well has **S = -1.39 pp**. Their difference is **+38.06 pp**, so the VUAA1 ratio is **N = 1.000**. The value 1 in the Results heatmap is this reference ratio, not a corrected change of 1 pp. The bars, the table below and the heatmap use the same Test 2 endpoints; no response values were changed to produce this display. For VUAA1, the within-F1 change is **+34.09%**, while F0 changes **-2.57%**. Their disturbance-corrected contrast is **S = +36.67 pp**. The DMSO well has **S = -1.39 pp**, giving a separate vehicle difference of **+38.06 pp**. The matched-duration sensitivity value for VUAA1 is **S48 = +19.67 pp**. S answers whether the recorded F1 trajectory changes more than the recorded F0 trajectory. It does not compare the absolute mean F1 level with the preceding mean F0 level. Those acquisitions can begin at different fluorescence levels, so a rising F1 trace and a lower F1 mean are compatible. The earlier mean-ratio calculation remains in the [audit summary](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/parts-data/c324535fe528-well-summary.csv) and is not the primary response measure here. The two windows differ in duration (168 s versus 48 s), so S is not a matched-duration rate correction. This screen contains one observed well per condition–addition pair; repeated readings do not supply independent cultures. Positive S means F1 changes more, or decreases less, than F0; it need not imply a raw F1 increase. It is not proof of receptor-specific activation, calcium influx, selectivity or a detection limit. Negative values are not classified as inhibition. The [exploratory VUAA1-referenced supplement](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156#odor-2026-10-21-vuaa1-reference) rescales the separate odorant-minus-DMSO contrasts by this condition's VUAA1-minus-DMSO contrast, **+38.06 pp**. It retains the S values above and does not measure or correct per-well transfection efficiency. Attachments: [corrected 72-well summary](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/parts-data/37cf3f799488-change-summary.csv), [import provenance](https://static.igem.wiki/teams/6460/wiki/parts-data/8de9b0e74dac-import-manifest.json) and [shared methods](https://registry.igem.org/collections/40067138-a3dd-4e5b-b8a4-50b097ee0156#odor-2026-10-21-methods). Dates, raw identifiers and unmodified source measurements remain in the provenance record.
